# Crystal Ball

![Crystal Ball](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/crystal_ball.png)

Heads: 5 points. Tails: discard one of the next three coins.

- **Rarity:** Rare
- **Heads chance:** 50%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 5 points

## Tails
Discard one of the next three coins

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Seer](characters-seer)
